target.title: fix(memory-wiki): prevent distinct titles from silently overwriting each other
target.body:
## Summary

Two distinct memory-wiki pages whose titles slugify to the same value silently overwrite each other, and the first page is permanently lost.

The agent-facing path is `wiki_apply` with op `create_synthesis`. When an agent saves a synthesis titled "Q3 Report" and later saves a different synthesis titled "Q3-Report", both resolve to `syntheses/q3-report.md` under id `synthesis.q3-report`. The second write overwrites the first: the first synthesis's managed Summary, sourceIds, claims, and confidence are gone, and neither `wiki_get` nor `wiki_search` can recover them. No error or warning is surfaced.

`slugifyWikiSegment` collapses case, spaces, and punctuation, so realistic agent-generated titles collide: "Q3 Report" / "Q3-Report", "Project Alpha!" / "Project Alpha", "Sales (2026)" / "Sales 2026", "Meeting Notes" / "meeting notes". The sibling CLI path `wiki ingest` has the same defect for `sources/<slug>.md`.

## Root cause

`extensions/memory-wiki/src/apply.ts` derived the synthesis page path and id from the bare slug, with no disambiguation when an existing page at that slug belongs to a different title:

```ts
// before
const slug = slugifyWikiSegment(params.mutation.title);
const pagePath = path.join("syntheses", `${slug}.md`).replace(/\\/g, "/");
const root = await fsRoot(params.config.vault.path);
const existing = await root.readText(pagePath).catch(() => "");
```

`slugifyWikiSegment` only appends a hash when the slug exceeds the byte cap (`extensions/memory-wiki/src/markdown.ts`), so short colliding titles get no hash. `ingest.ts` had the identical pattern for `source.<slug>`.

## Fix

Add one shared identity helper and route both writers through it. The plain readable slug is reused when it is free or already owns the same title (so re-applying a synthesis still updates in place); a distinct title that lands on an existing page gets a stable title-hash suffix, matching the existing `okf.ts` hashed-identity pattern:

```ts
// after (markdown.ts)
export async function resolveTitleKeyedWikiSlug(params: {
  title: string;
  readExistingTitleBySlug: (slug: string) => Promise<string | undefined>;
}): Promise<string> {
  const baseSlug = slugifyWikiSegment(params.title);
  const existingTitle = await params.readExistingTitleBySlug(baseSlug);
  if (existingTitle === undefined || existingTitle.trim() === params.title.trim()) {
    return baseSlug;
  }
  const suffix = createHash("sha1").update(params.title).digest("hex").slice(0, WIKI_SEGMENT_HASH_BYTES);
  return `${baseSlug}-${suffix}`;
}
```

`apply.ts` (`create_synthesis`) and `ingest.ts` (`wiki ingest`) both resolve their slug through this helper before reading/writing the page.

The "existing title" is read the same way query and compile resolve a page's effective title (`extensions/memory-wiki/src/markdown.ts`): frontmatter `title`, then the first `# ` H1 heading, then the file name. So a page that occupies the target slug but has no frontmatter (a supported hand-authored raw source page) is recognized as occupied and gets a distinct slug for the incoming title instead of being silently overwritten. The helper also canonicalizes the title once (trimmed) and uses that single value for the base slug, the existing-title comparison, and the hash suffix, so two writes of the same logical title that differ only by surrounding whitespace land on the same page instead of forking a duplicate.

## Why this is the right boundary

- The helper lives next to `slugifyWikiSegment` and reuses the same `WIKI_SEGMENT_HASH_BYTES` and SHA-1 pattern already used by `okf.ts`/`createWikiPageFilename`. Two call sites share it (synthesis and source), so it pays rent.
- Backward compatible with no vault migration: the common single-page-per-title case keeps its plain `<slug>.md` path because the stored title matches. Only genuine distinct-title collisions get a hashed path, so existing vaults and same-title re-applies are unchanged.
- Covers both managed and unmanaged pages: collision detection compares the incoming title against the existing page's effective title (frontmatter title, else H1, else file name), so a no-frontmatter raw source page is protected, not just generated pages that carry a `title` field.
- Prior art: closed PR #65992 proposed a source-path-keyed fix for the ingest half only and was closed unmerged; merged PR #64742 fixed only the Unicode/empty-slug case. Neither touched `create_synthesis`, and the distinct-title slug collision is still live on current `main` (proof below). This change fixes the agent-facing synthesis path that no prior PR addressed, and removes the same live collision from the source path with one helper.

## Verification

From a worktree with deps (node at /opt/node/bin):

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-wiki/src/slug-collision.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/wiki-notes-read-retry.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/apply.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/ingest.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/markdown.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/query.test.ts` -> 72 passed
- `slug-collision.test.ts` regressions fail on pristine `main` and pass with this patch: distinct synthesis titles, distinct ingest titles, a no-frontmatter raw source page colliding with a generated ingest title, and a colliding title re-applied with surrounding whitespace updating its existing hashed page instead of duplicating it.
- `wiki-notes-read-retry.test.ts` regressions fail on previous PR head 499bffe00e and pass with this patch: transient title-read failures during colliding synthesis creation and source ingest still allocate the distinct hash-suffixed page instead of reusing the occupied bare slug.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint extensions/memory-wiki/src/apply.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/ingest.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/markdown.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/slug-collision.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/wiki-notes-read-retry.test.ts` -> clean
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/memory-wiki/src/apply.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/ingest.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/markdown.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/slug-collision.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/wiki-notes-read-retry.test.ts` -> clean
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p extensions/memory-wiki/tsconfig.json` -> exit 0
- Branch rebased onto current `origin/main` 76ccd17ac3.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: distinct memory-wiki syntheses and ingested sources whose titles slugify to the same value no longer overwrite each other and silently lose the first page.
Real environment tested: drove the real `applyMemoryWikiMutation` (`create_synthesis`) and the real `ingestMemoryWikiSource` (`wiki ingest`) against temp vaults read from disk after each run, on pristine main at origin/main 9ff7abc8989c1770856b27d5b06e6bb6695ce666 with the original production files restored, on previous PR head 499bffe00e with the retry repair absent, and on PR head f7ca15a483 with this patch applied, identical inputs for each before/after pair. The transient-read run injected one filesystem `ENOENT` at the existing source page read boundary; all vault writes, page parsing, slug resolution, and disk reads stayed production code.
Exact steps or command run after this patch: apply `create_synthesis` "Q3 Report" (body "Revenue grew 12 percent", source.finance, claim.q3.revenue), then apply `create_synthesis` "Q3-Report" (body "Headcount fell 4 percent"); separately `wiki ingest` "Q3 Report" then "Q3-Report"; ingest "Q3 Report" onto a pre-seeded hand-authored no-frontmatter sources/q3-report.md; re-apply "  Q3-Report  "; then run `wiki ingest` "Q3 Report" followed by `wiki ingest` "Q3-Report" while the first read of the occupied `sources/q3-report.md` returns `ENOENT`; list each directory and read each page from disk.
Evidence after fix:
```
# BEFORE (pristine origin/main, three prod files reverted, driver identical)
create_synthesis distinct titles 'Q3 Report' then 'Q3-Report'
  first  pagePath=syntheses/q3-report.md
  second pagePath=syntheses/q3-report.md
  synthesis page files (count=1): ["q3-report.md"]
  first synthesis body keeps 'Revenue grew 12 percent': false
  first synthesis body keeps source 'source.finance': false
  wiki_search('Revenue grew 12 percent') recovers first synthesis: false
wiki ingest distinct titles 'Q3 Report' then 'Q3-Report'
  source page files (count=1): ["q3-report.md"]
  ingest A page keeps 'finance source body': false
ingest onto hand-authored no-frontmatter sources/q3-report.md
  ingest wrote to: sources/q3-report.md
  hand-authored q3-report.md keeps 'Hand authored raw source.': false

# AFTER (this patch, head 888df0ffcfecdce17a9b6c577b7d71f3109c02a9, identical inputs)
create_synthesis distinct titles 'Q3 Report' then 'Q3-Report'
  first  pagePath=syntheses/q3-report.md
  second pagePath=syntheses/q3-report-97358135a013.md
  synthesis page files (count=2): ["q3-report-97358135a013.md","q3-report.md"]
  first synthesis body keeps 'Revenue grew 12 percent': true
  first synthesis body keeps source 'source.finance': true
  wiki_search('Revenue grew 12 percent') recovers first synthesis: true
wiki ingest distinct titles 'Q3 Report' then 'Q3-Report'
  source page files (count=2): ["q3-report-97358135a013.md","q3-report.md"]
  ingest A page keeps 'finance source body': true
  ingest B page keeps 'headcount source body': true
ingest onto hand-authored no-frontmatter sources/q3-report.md
  ingest wrote to: sources/q3-report-4d84a9cac68c.md
  hand-authored q3-report.md keeps 'Hand authored raw source.': true
re-apply '  Q3-Report  ' (whitespace variant of existing 'Q3-Report')
  re-apply wrote to: syntheses/q3-report-97358135a013.md
  updates the existing hashed page in place, no duplicate: true
  synthesis page files (count): ["q3-report-97358135a013.md","q3-report.md"]

# BEFORE (previous PR head 499bffe00e, transient source title read)
first pagePath=sources/q3-report.md
second pagePath=sources/q3-report.md
injected transient read failure: true
source page files (count=1): ["q3-report.md"]
first page keeps finance source body: false
second page keeps headcount source body: true

# AFTER (this patch, head f7ca15a483, identical transient source title read)
first pagePath=sources/q3-report.md
second pagePath=sources/q3-report-97358135a013.md
injected transient read failure: true
source page files (count=2): ["q3-report-97358135a013.md","q3-report.md"]
first page keeps finance source body: true
second page keeps headcount source body: true
```
Observed result after fix: on pristine main both distinct titles collapse onto one bare-slug page, the first synthesis body and source.finance are gone, neither wiki_search nor the on-disk page can recover them, and a real ingest overwrites a hand-authored raw page; on the previous PR head a transient existing-page title read still makes the colliding source write back to the occupied bare slug and lose the first body; after the patch the second distinct title gets a stable title-hash slug, both pages persist with their own body and sources even after the transient read failure, search recovers the first synthesis, the hand-authored raw page is left intact, and re-applying the same title with only surrounding whitespace updates the existing hashed page in place instead of forking a duplicate.
What was not tested: no full `pnpm check` or `pnpm build` (OOM-prone box); two ingested sources given an identical explicit title still merge by design, since the trimmed title is the page identity here.
